description: This file implements a WebSocket server utility class (WSServer) with methods to start, handle upgrades, and close the server, including configuration for per-message deflate compression and connection management.

classes.name: WSServer
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket server lifecycle, handling connections, upgrades, and shutdown.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes WSServer with a delegate for handling server events.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the HTTP and WebSocket server, returning the WebSocket endpoint URL.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the WebSocket and HTTP servers, closing all connections.
